purpose: T055's registered CROSS-FAMILY anchor test: WHERE is the net-family boundary? e099's five-arm structure verbatim (none/vzero/noise/promptcopy/randomize; matched seed-7 streams) + crossfamily: the e021_task copy-task net's OWN free-run V entries (its own corpus, two native block-256 windows; p<=255 position-matched, p in [256,387] <- window2 p-192; recipient L/H 0..3 <- donor L/H 0..3, d=32) spliced into the anchor band the way randomize did. Readouts: clean-judge gap (final-128 tail) + terminal unigram SKL cluster map. FROZEN bars: gap > 1 AND joins collapsed cluster => FAMILY = TRAINED WEIGHTS; gap < 0.3 AND joins healthy cluster => FAMILY = GENERIC STATS; else MIXED.

donor_run_determinism.rule: window-1 rerun (same seeds) tokens + V caches bit-identical

seeds.donor_note: donor windows use DEDICATED prompt/sample generators (never touching arm streams); donor content frozen before all arms

protocol.within_null: 35 disjoint 4-vs-4 sequence splits per arm, symmetric KL

arms.randomize: V<-sibling battery row's entry at the same position (e099.generate_arm5 verbatim, seed-4343 derangement, pre-event snapshot) — same trained net
arms.crossfamily: V<-e021_task copy-task net's own free-run entries on its own corpus (e105 extension; see purpose)
arms.promptcopy: V<-same row's pristine prompt entry (e080 verbatim) — corpus-text control

schedule.note: identical to e080/e099: replaced once at first band admission, K untouched; all six arms token-identical through position 164; 324 replaced positions

protocol.collapse_gate: clean-judge tail CE - online tail CE > 1.0 nats (e099 convention)

cluster_rule.calibration: verified on e099's published grid: classifies all five e099 arms correctly

gates.threads_note: e080 module import sets 12; overridden to 8 (task spec / T050)

donor_run_determinism.rule: window-1 rerun (same seeds) tokens + V caches bit-identical

G6_crossfamily_determinism.rule: crossfamily arm (donors regenerated + seed-7 stream) rerun token stream bit-identical

donor_position_map.rule: p<=255 <- window1 pos p; p in [256,387] <- window2 pos p-192; all source positions within donor-native generated band 64..255; zero reuse

crossfamily_stats.position_map: p<=255 <- donor1[:, :, p, :] (position-matched); p in [256,387] <- donor2[:, :, p-192, :] (donor-native 64..195, no reuse)
crossfamily_stats.layer_head_map: recipient layer li (0..3) <- donor layer li; recipient head h (0..3) <- donor head h; d=32

G4_rerun_vs_e099.note: five legacy arms rerun vs runs/e099/metrics.json: max dev 0.00e+00 (online tail CE, clean-judge, per-seq gap; same 8-thread setting -> expect ~1e-7)

donor_rider.note: NON-REGISTERED rider: the donor net's own generated-text statistics (pooled final-128 tails of both donor windows, 16x128 tokens) vs the recipient arms

registered_decision.verdict: FAMILY = TRAINED WEIGHTS fires: the cross-family arm COLLAPSED (clean-judge gap +5.094 > 1.0) and its terminal distribution joined the collapsed cluster (d_c 0.410 = 1.0x floor_c, below the 2.0x bar; d_h 1.655 above d_c) — a differently-TRAINED net's generated entries cannot anchor the run where the same trained net's sibling entries do.
